title: Triangulated bounded constructibility for admissible coefficients
statement: Let l be prime and k a field of positive characteristic p different from l. Let X be separated of finite type over k and let Λ be an admissible commutative condensed coefficient ring [sk-def-localizing-closure]. In the ordinary derived category of internal modules over Λ_X [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom], the property of bounded cohomology with finite constant scalar constructible models [sk-def-sfb-constructible] is triangulated: it contains zero, is stable under all integer shifts, and is closed under extensions in distinguished triangles.

source.place: Step 2; zero, shifts and extensions before the final devissage

proof.text: First replace the Type-0 finite discrete coefficient A by ULift(A) in the scheme universe, using the explicit continuous-map condensed ring isomorphism induced by ULift.ringEquiv. For this coefficient use the normalized Encoding from internal modules to sheaves of ordinary ULift(A)-modules. Its constructibility comparison identifies bounded constant-model constructibility with bounded constructible homology after the exact derived equivalence. The ordinary local-model and IsConstructible predicates differ only in their cover-index universes: lift the small index in one direction and use Precoverage.Small to shrink it in the other. The fixed-scalar kernel, cokernel and extension closure proved in ConstructibleCoefficientSerre, together with its etale-origin zero model, gives a weak Serre class. The cohomology weak Serre theorem, intersected with canonical boundedness, is triangulated. Pull back this property along the exact derived encoding.

source.place: Step 2; zero, shifts and extensions before the final devissage

proof.text: The finite-type scheme X is locally Noetherian and quasi-compact, hence Noetherian. For each finite subextension E, use isConstantModelConstructible_serre_padicIntegers for kernels, cokernels and short exact extensions over its actual condensed valuation ring. Zero has the rank-zero presentation, the identity cover and the trivial one-stratum stratification, even on the empty scheme. Constructibility is invariant under isomorphism. Apply the cohomology weak Serre theorem and intersect with boundedness to get triangulated bounded constructibility for O_E. The existing field-coefficient theorem gives the assertion for E and the finite-subextension-valued algebraic closure.

source.place: Step 2; zero, shifts and extensions before the final devissage

proof.text: For a monoid-object coefficient isomorphism, restrict scalars along its inverse and pull the map to X. This is an exact equivalence. The constantModel_comap_iff proof in IntegralConstantModelHeartClosure transports the finite scalar presentation on the point, then the same covers and strata; thus it preserves and reflects exactly IsConstantModelConstructible. The derived homology comparison and faithful-exact reflection of boundedness identify the bounded predicate with the inverse image of the representative predicate. Isomorphism invariance and the standard triangulated-inverse-image instance transfer triangulatedness. Finally split the six admissibility cases. The base-coefficient condensed identifications take Q_l and Z_l to the bottom finite subextension and its valuation ring. Compose these with the supplied monoid-object isomorphisms and apply the preceding finite, integral and field cases.

theorem admissible_boundedConstructible_isTriangulated
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (hΛ : IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ℓ Λ) :
    (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X).IsTriangulated
